Synthetic HEIC files for tests. None comes from an extraction.

- plain.heic: 200x120, a red block at x 10-59, y 10-29 (saved by macOS sips)
- orientation.heic: the same picture with Exif Orientation 6 and the matching rotation
- grid_alpha.heic: 1100x700, alpha stored as a grid of its own (saved by sips): opaque inside an
  ellipse, transparent outside, half transparent in the first 40 columns
- exif_datetime.heic: 8x8 with Exif DateTime 2024:01:02 03:04:05
